purpose: Exploratory pilot of coordinate-centered phase linearization, with equal-gate and equal-training controls; no novelty claim.
training: Separate original 16 groups; original full normalized energy, original normalization; 768 evaluations each; same and refitted angles. No secrets, optima or development labels used in training.
limitations: Exploratory old64 development cases, not final validation.
The field linearization principle has prior art in quantum annealing and classical optimization; no new-algorithm priority claim.
Single-coordinate energy preservation does not guarantee useful sampling from the uniform initial state.
No QPU use or secure ML-KEM attack.
